create_policy_network: create a Policy network with CNNBase or MLPBase for reinforcement learning environments
build_cnn_base: build a CNNBase convolutional neural network for image-based observation spaces with optional GRU recurrence
build_mlp_base: build an MLPBase multi-layer perceptron network for vector observation spaces with actor and critic heads
run_policy_act: run the Policy act method to sample actions and compute values from observation inputs
evaluate_policy_actions: evaluate precomputed actions through the Policy to get log probabilities and distribution entropy
